content.short: Fintopio is a secure, user-friendly DeFi wallet that integrates with Telegram for in-chat cryptocurrency transactions.
content.description: Fintopio is a secure, easy-to-use DeFi wallet that integrates directly with Telegram, giving you convenient access to your digital assets within a familiar chat environment. It never stores private keys or seed phrases, so you remain in full control of your security and holdings. With Fintopio, you can create new wallets and manage existing ones right inside Telegram, send and receive funds, sign and approve transactions, and explore a range of blockchain services, all while prioritizing strong protection and straightforward usability.
content.meta: Fintopio simplifies Telegram payments, enabling in-chat cryptocurrency transactions. Discover Fintopio and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
